item.title: Ask the Way to the Metro
item.prompt_text: You are in a new part of Tashkent and you want to take the metro. Stop a person in the street. Say excuse me, ask where the nearest metro station is, ask if it is far, and say thank you.
item.target_grammar: Where is…? / Is it…? / Can I…? questions
item.fluency_objective: Ask your questions one after the other without long pauses.
item.pronunciation_objective: Use a polite, rising tone on 'Excuse me?' and on yes/no questions like 'Is it far?'
item.model_answer: Excuse me, can you help me, please? I want to take the metro. Where is the nearest metro station? Is it far from here? Can I walk there? Ten minutes on foot? OK, great. Straight on and then left. Thank you very much! Have a nice day.
item.model_opening: Excuse me, can you help me, please?
